artwork.prompt: Album cover artwork, square format. A 2017 sleeve deliberately styled after 1955-1979. Medium: modernist graphic design in flat cut-paper shapes. Not a depiction — an abstract composition that only distantly evokes a circuit trace at macro scale. Palette: ultramarine, silver, black, one acid highlight. Composition: strict grid, large flat colour fields. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
